ability_body: An open-source, data-driven ability framework for Godot 4.x, built with C++ and GDExtension.
ability_detail: Tag hierarchies, ability phases, composable Resources, and multiplayer prediction and rollback are central to its design.
ability_status: Preparing for public distribution; compatibility and CI are evolving.
about_body1: I started learning and building software in 2020, alongside work in customer-facing and operational roles. That experience keeps my engineering grounded in how people actually use tools and where everyday work gets stuck.
about_body2: Today I focus on applied AI and full stack products. Vectora is my main independent project: a place to explore agent runtimes, developer workbenches, safety boundaries, and the discipline of shipping software in small, reviewable steps.
about_principle: Make the powerful parts useful, observable, and under human control.
about_title: Product-minded by nature. Engineer by practice.
contact_body: I'm open to conversations about software engineering, applied AI, developer tools, and product work. Tell me what you're building.
contact_title: Have a thoughtful problem to solve?
delivery_body: A product concept for restaurant menus and ordering, designed around the everyday flow from browsing a menu to managing an order.
delivery_detail: The experience covers categories, search, item variations, add-ons, pricing, cart, checkout, and order management, with a mobile-first product design.
delivery_status: In active development. A dedicated subdomain site is planned for a future stage.
expertise_intro: I enjoy the seams between disciplines: where a user need becomes a system, where an agent meets real permissions, and where a prototype becomes dependable software.

projects_intro: I take ideas from product discovery through implementation, security, and operation. Each project is shown at its actual stage of maturity.
skill_agents_body: Tool-using agents, human approval, subagents, memory, retrieval, model routing, and evaluation workflows.
skill_product_body: React, TypeScript, TanStack, Tailwind, desktop apps, UX flows, and translating product ideas into usable interfaces.
skill_quality_body: Negative and regression tests, CI, observability, workspace isolation, credential protection, and clear maturity signals.

vectora_body: A developer environment where people and AI agents work in the same project, with shared code context, tools, and human oversight.
vectora_detail: Its published feature set includes a native conversation loop, 10 specialized subagents, multi-agent Kanban, a Context Graph for around 30 languages, hybrid RAG, and integrated terminal, Git, and browser workbenches. Maturity varies by capability as the product evolves.
